classes.label: Plan records (in code)
classes.definition: What .aes/target.yaml declares: outcomes, rules, criteria, components and the files planned for them.

classes.label: Changing the plan (in code)
classes.definition: How the target changes: a proposal with a delta, accepted into a plan record.

classes.label: Evidence (in code)
classes.definition: Observations bound to a commit, their freshness, and the standing they give each criterion.

classes.label: Current state (in code)
classes.definition: What HEAD contains, how it differs from the plan, and the gaps that remain.

classes.label: Context and project records (in code)
classes.definition: Project settings, the working-context packet, the v0.1 repository context, and the project brain.

classes.label: Only in documents
classes.definition: Named in the goal, decisions or plans, with no code here that implements it.

classes.label: Written by another tool
classes.definition: Records stored here that another tool (Company Planning) writes and reads; no AES code reads them.

classes.label: Retired (history)
classes.definition: Removed on 2026-10-14; documents still describe it.

classes.label: AES as a whole (named in documents)
classes.definition: AES and its three parts as Brian names them (2026-11-11); umbrella names with no single code location.

classes.label: Feedback loop (in code)
classes.definition: The nightly loop in scripts/learning_loop that turns what happened in agent sessions into filed reports.

classes.label: One-tool design (planned, not built here yet)
classes.definition: Parts of the one planning-and-checking tool in proposals/one-planning-tool/DESIGN.md; built in six slices.

classes.label: Lives in another repository today
classes.definition: Parts of AES whose code is in another repository today (lockstep, code2-template, code2-workspace).

ambiguous.note: Lockstep names both today's pcw package in its own repository and the one tool it becomes in this repository (DESIGN.md line 17); say which.
`lockstep check` runs the commit checks; `lockstep plan check` checks plans and acceptance files.
The AES rules register lists rules the feedback loop licensed; Brian's agent rules are in code2-workspace agents/ (Q20).
A Company Planning plan is sometimes called a proposal (proposals/ folders); an AES proposal is the record `aes plan validate` reads before acceptance.
